sources.fact: Android SDR_VIDEO public value 3 maps to internal SMPTE170M; ISO transfer mapping uses 1 as main with aliases 6,14,15. Linear public value 1 maps to ISO transfer 8. BT2020 primaries and nonconstant matrix are ISO9.
COLOR_TRANSFER_SDR_VIDEO=3 represents the SMPTE170M transfer characteristic used by BT601/BT709/BT2020, whereas COLOR_TRANSFER_LINEAR=1 is linear.
getInputImage/getOutputImage expose Image plane buffers; output Image is read-only and only valid while the associated output buffer is owned by the caller.
